scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec db psql -U citizen -d citizen_connect
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env) && (test -f server/.env || cp server/.env.example server/.env)
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix server start
